turns.text: Our triage workflow is spending too much on the agent step. Can we cap it?
The step has no budget today. Options: limit the trigger to issues with the needs-triage label, or set `max_turns: 10` on the agent command.
Added the label filter and `--max-turns 10`. Validated.
Actually remove the max turns, it cut answers in half last time.
Removed it; only the label filter stays.
